title: Incline or flat bench for upper chest? 📐
caption:
A moderate incline, about 30 degrees, shifts more work to the upper chest. Go too steep and your shoulders take over. Flat bench still trains the whole chest. Incline or flat first? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 13
first_comment: Incline first or flat first? Wrong answers only 😂
